text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 — multiple containers on rwinf-gpu-12 reporting OOMs + CUDA driver resets. Auto-evict kicked in 01:12 UTC. Notifying on-call.

maya: ack i'm on it. seeing repeated OOMs on paged-attn allocator, slow memory creep over last 6 hours.

raj: copying recent pod logs, looks like fragmentation but memory never drops:
```
[2024-06-12T01:08:32Z] runtime: cuda error 700, driver reset
[2024-06-12T01:09:02Z] paged-attn: page_alloc: retire slab=0x7fbd... fragmented=+12MB
[2024-06-12T01:11:58Z] containerd: oom_kill -> pid 24321 (inference_worker)
```

fiona: any recent deploys? i rolled a config change to allocator thresholds ~00:30 UTC (reduced conservative-evict window). could be related.

maya: good call. i'm seeing the eviction threshold lowered to 0.6 from 0.75. that would make compaction less aggressive.

raj: telemetry shows KV cache resident pages rising steadily for certain shards, fragmentation metric > 84% for paged pools.

ops-bot: Note: affected customers on prod-region-eu may see increased latencies and transient 5xx for generator endpoints. Support pinged.

support-liaison: I've opened a ticket and alerted top-10 customers on the impacted region with a short blurb.

maya: immediate mitigation plan: 1) cordon rwinf-gpu-12, 2) drain non-critical pods, 3) restart inference pods one-by-one with environment var DEBUG_ALLOCATOR=1, 4) increase compaction aggressiveness via runtime flag --kv-compact-threshold=0.55 (temporary). will monitor.

raj: can we avoid full restart for all? some pods have long-lived in-flight sessions. propose canary restart first (two pods) then escalate.

maya: agreed. canary two pods now.

fiona: adding quick script to force a compact on a running process:
```bash
# run on node with root privileges
sudo nsenter -t $(pidof inference_worker) -m -- /usr/local/bin/allocator_ctl compact --target=0.5
```

raj: ran compact on pod inference-55, resident dropped ~900MB and fragmentation improved to 62%. good signal.

ops-bot: Observability: per-token latency spike from 80ms -> 420ms for affected model variant, error rate ~12% for the last 18 minutes.

support-liaison: customers updated with ETA 45m for mitigation. will follow up if any regression.

maya: node cordoned. starting rolling restart of inference pods (canary first).

fiona: while restarts are in progress, i bumped eviction policy on the node to be more aggressive:
```yaml
# runtime config snippet
allocator:
  eviction:
    target_utilization: 0.58
    min_free_pages: 30
```

raj: note: GPU metrics show occasional PCIe timeouts before CUDA reset. could be unrelated hardware flakiness, but correlation with fragmentation suggests allocator stress. I've pinged infra-team to run a quick hardware/driver check.

infra-team: acknowledged, we'll run nvidia-smi -q and check driver logs. spare node prepared as hot-standby if rwinf-gpu-12 needs to be evacuated.

maya: canary pods restarted, logs show no immediate OOM after compact and adjusted flags. continuing roll.

ops-bot: Incident timeline summary (auto): detection 01:12 UTC, mitigation started 01:18 UTC, canary success 01:29 UTC.

raj: capturing diagnostic artifacts for postmortem: allocator histograms, slab maps, pmap of processes, kernel dmesg around driver resets.

fiona: i'm reverting my config change (allocator thresholds) to previous values and will stage a safer rollout with more telemetry.

support-liaison: customers acknowledged, lowering severity notice to advisory if error rates continue falling.

maya: handoff: i'm on call until 02:00 UTC; after that raj will take over. key actions for oncoming oncall: 1) monitor fragmentation trends (chart: paged_pool_frag_pct), 2) be ready to trigger node evac if OOMs return, 3) coordinate with infra for driver inspection.

raj: taking handoff at 02:00 UTC. leaving a bookmark to follow up on long-tail memory creep alerts and schedule a targeted compaction run across nodes at low traffic window.

infra-team: found repeated ECC errors on rwinf-gpu-12 around 00:50 UTC, isolating for hardware validation. moving to spare node for workload.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: mitigation progressed: rolling restarts complete, compaction and eviction settings restored to safe baseline, error rate down to 1.8% and latency returning to normal. continuing monitoring for 2 hours.

maya: thanks team. will file incident ticket with initial impact numbers and attach artifacts.

support-liaison: posted customer follow-up note. will escalate if anything regresses.

raj: logging follow-up items: (1) add auto-triggered compact when frag > 80% for >10m, (2) revert-safe deploy gating on allocator threshold changes, (3) add node-level watchdog for PCIe/driver errors.

oncall-bot: Handoff complete -> next oncall: raj.
